name: open-articulated
title: Open a door or drawer
description: Open a door, drawer, refrigerator door or microwave door to its annotated open value. The method is chosen automatically from the part: powered microwave (door button + hinge), refrigerator handle, drawer handle pull, hinged door side-hook ride, or a door opened by the right hand while the left hand holds a load.
use_when: A door, drawer or appliance must be opened before reaching inside.

not_to_be_confused_with.press: press only pushes a button; open guarantees the door is open.

articulated.description: The door, drawer or appliance door.

applicability.summary: Requires base_near(place=$articulated). Some bound nouns add preconditions (see Conditions that depend on the bound nouns).

preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

postconditions.meaning: Joint at least 60 % of the way from closed to its annotated open value.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

arg_formats.articulated_ref: an annotated door, drawer or appliance door

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
